title: Platform assistant
empty: Tell me what you want to do in the platform, for example: «add a ticket type called Technical problem to my unit». I will ask for anything missing and you confirm before anything is done.
placeholder: Write what you want to do…
thinking: The assistant is working on it…
readOnly: You can read this conversation but not write to the assistant.

draft.title: Request waiting for your confirmation
draft.destructive: This deletes something. Check the name before you confirm.
draft.expiredHint: This request expired. Ask the assistant again.
draft.pictures: Pictures that will go with the request

agent-chat.title: The platform assistant
agent-chat.body: Tell the assistant what you want to do instead of going through several pages, and attach a screenshot or speak when that explains it better. It asks for anything missing, shows you what it will do, and does it only after you confirm, with your own permissions.

images.label: Choose pictures to attach
images.prompt: Drop the picture here, or click to browse
images.hint: PNG or JPG, up to {{max}} pictures. You can also paste a screenshot with Ctrl/Cmd+V.
images.notice: Do not attach sensitive data (salaries, ID numbers). Only you can see your pictures; they are also sent to the AI service so the assistant can read them.

voice.label: Choose a sound file
voice.prompt: Drop the sound file here, or click to browse
voice.hint: Any sound file your browser can play (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg…), up to 5 minutes.
voice.notice: Do not say sensitive data (salaries, ID numbers). Your recording is sent to the AI service to be written down and is not kept; you read the text before it is sent.

both.label: Choose pictures or a sound file
both.prompt: Drop a picture or a sound file here, or click to browse
both.hint: Pictures: PNG or JPG, up to {{max}}. Sound: any file your browser can play, up to 5 minutes.
both.notice: Do not attach or say sensitive data (salaries, ID numbers). Pictures and recordings are sent to the AI service; only you see your pictures, and a recording is not kept.

voice.cut: The speech was longer than a message, so the text was cut at the limit.
voice.nothing: No speech was heard in the sound. Try again.
voice.tooLong: The sound is longer than 5 minutes. Record or choose a shorter one.
voice.unreadable: This browser cannot read that sound file. Try mp3, m4a or wav.
voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in the browser, then try again.
voice.unsupported: This browser cannot record. Choose a sound file instead.
